source: Pediatric Saudi Board Exams Question Collection, 4th Edition (1 May 2026)

questions.stemEn: An unvaccinated patient presents with high-grade fever and images showing a rash and buccal lesions suggestive of measles. Which statement is true regarding the diagnosis?

options.text: Koplik spots usually appear about 2 days before the rash

questions.explanationAr: في المصدر، Koplik spots تظهر تقريبًا قبل الـexanthem بـ48 ساعة، وغالبًا تكون على buccal mucosa مقابل molar teeth. لذلك ظهورها قبل الطفح من العلامات الـhigh-yield للـmeasles.
questions.reasoningEn: The source states that Koplik spots may appear approximately 48 hours before the measles exanthem.
questions.clinicalPearl: Koplik spots precede the measles rash and are a highly characteristic enanthem.

image.description: Two original images of measles rash and buccal lesion are referenced in the source.

questions.stemEn: An 18-month-old unvaccinated boy presents with fever, cough and a rash consistent with measles. Measles-related mortality in children is most commonly due to which complication?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يذكر أن pneumonia هي أكثر أسباب الوفاة المرتبطة بالـmeasles عند الأطفال، لذلك هي الإجابة المسترجعة في هذا السؤال.
questions.reasoningEn: The source identifies pneumonia as the most common cause of measles-associated death in children.

incorrectOptionsAr.B: Encephalitis من المضاعفات الخطيرة لكنه ليس السبب الأكثر شيوعًا للوفاة حسب المصدر.
incorrectOptionsAr.C: Acute rheumatic fever ليس complication للـmeasles.
incorrectOptionsAr.D: Otitis media شائعة لكنها ليست السبب الرئيسي للوفاة.

questions.clinicalPearl: Pneumonia is the key fatal complication tested in pediatric measles questions.

questions.stemEn: A 10-month-old boy presents with cough, fever, respiratory distress, hypoxia, wheezing and acute otitis media. A chest X-ray image is provided. What is the most likely causative organism?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يصف صورة bronchiolitis-like illness مع fever، wheeze، hypoxia وotitis media، ويربط هذا النمط بـ human metapneumovirus (hMPV).
questions.reasoningEn: The source links this bronchiolitis-like presentation, including otitis media, to human metapneumovirus.

incorrectOptionsAr.B: Rhinovirus ممكن يسبب URTI/wheeze لكن المصدر يربط المجموعة الكاملة من العلامات هنا بـ hMPV.
incorrectOptionsAr.C: Mycoplasma أكثر شيوعًا في الأطفال الأكبر ولا يطابق نمط bronchiolitis في هذا الرضيع.

questions.clinicalPearl: hMPV is an important viral cause of bronchiolitis-like disease in young children.

questions.stemEn: An infant is admitted with acute bronchiolitis. Testing is negative for RSV, COVID-19 and influenza A and B. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: بعد استبعاد الفيروسات المذكورة في السؤال، المصدر يختار human metapneumovirus كسبب محتمل آخر لbronchiolitis عند الرضع.
questions.reasoningEn: The source presents human metapneumovirus as the alternative viral cause after the listed common tests are negative.
questions.clinicalPearl: A negative RSV panel does not exclude other bronchiolitis viruses such as hMPV.

questions.stemEn: An unvaccinated child presents with unsteady gait, clumsiness, slurred speech and rapid repetitive eye movements. Two weeks earlier, she had a febrile illness with a skin rash that resolved spontaneously. What is the most likely cause of her current condition?
questions.explanationAr: الأعراض الحالية هي cerebellar signs بعد viral illness بحوالي أسبوعين. المصدر يذكر أن acute postinfectious cerebellar ataxia ارتبطت تقليديًا بـ varicella، ولذلك اختار VZV في هذا الـrecall.
questions.reasoningEn: The source describes a postinfectious acute cerebellar ataxia pattern and gives varicella-zoster virus as the recalled cause.
questions.clinicalPearl: A well child with acute cerebellar signs 1-3 weeks after a viral illness suggests postinfectious cerebellar ataxia.
diagnosticSteps: The source notes that acute structural, inflammatory, infectious and hemorrhagic causes must be excluded when clinically indicated.

sourceRefs.question: Q21
sourceRefs.additional: Similar to PREP 2023 Q118 and PREP 2020 Q78

verification.referenceNotes: Keep distinct from Part I recalls where a preceding GI prodrome may change the preferred organism.

questions.stemEn: A child had varicella infection two weeks ago and now presents with fever and new skin lesions shown in an image. What is the most likely causative organism for the clinical worsening?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يذكر أن primary varicella ترتبط بزيادة خطر invasive Group A Streptococcal soft-tissue infection، ومنها cellulitis وmyositis وnecrotizing fasciitis وtoxic shock syndrome. لذلك worsening مع fever وskin lesions بعد varicella يوجّه إلى GAS.
questions.reasoningEn: The source associates varicella with invasive group A streptococcal soft-tissue superinfection.
questions.clinicalPearl: Clinical deterioration after varicella should raise concern for invasive GAS soft-tissue infection.
